sloka: न खल्वन्येन काकुत्स्थ श्रोतव्यमिदमुत्तमम् ।परमम् ऋषिणा वीर त्वयैव रघुनन्दन ।। ७.९८.२२ ॥
transliteration: na khalvanyena kākutstha śrotavyamidamuttamam ।paramam ṛṣiṇā vīra tvayaiva raghunandana ।। 7.98.22 ॥

translations.english: Indeed, O Kakutstha, O hero, O delight of the Raghus, this excellent and supreme work, composed by the sage, is not to be heard by anyone else, but only by you.
